extraFacts.fact: An oil mist filter (coalescing filter) on the discharge of an oil-sealed vacuum pump captures oil fog and mist from the exhaust so it is not blown into the workplace, and the captured oil drains to the bottom of the housing; the filter element needs replacing when the pressure drop across it rises. A liquid separator or water separator in a vacuum line stops liquid being drawn into the pump or ejector.
extraFacts.source: Solberg and Gast vacuum filter product catalogues; general vacuum pump practice

extraFacts.fact: A vacuum ejector (vacuum generator) uses compressed air flowing through a nozzle to draw a vacuum with no moving parts; a suction pad holds with a force equal to the vacuum pressure difference times the pad area, so a safety factor must be applied for lifting. A vacuum regulator limits the vacuum applied to the pad circuit.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics guide 'Pneumatic grippers and vacuum'; SMC vacuum equipment catalogue

extraFacts.fact: Unit conversions: 1 bar = 14.5038 psi, so 102 psi is about 7 bar, 30 psi about 2 bar and 75 psi about 5.2 bar; 1 cfm = 1.699 cubic metres per hour (cmh) and 1 LPM = 0.06 cubic metres per hour. Temperature: deg C = (deg F - 32) / 1.8, so +40 deg F is about 4 deg C, +180 deg F about 82 deg C, +220 deg F about 104 deg C, +122 deg F is 50 deg C and 176 deg F is 80 deg C.
Customs classification: vacuum pumps and parts, including ejectors, fall under HS heading 8414; filtering and purifying machinery under 8421; pressure-reducing valves under 8481.
extraFacts.source: WCO Harmonized System Nomenclature 2022, headings 84.14, 84.21 and 84.81

extraFacts.fact: Sibling listings on indushydraulics.com: SMC AMJ water separators have 1/4, 3/8, 3/4 and 1 inch ports; SMC ZP series adaptors are M4 to M8 and 1/8 inch; SMC IRV vacuum regulators are 1/8 to 3/8 inch; SMC vacuum ejectors use nozzles of 0.5 to 2 mm; Solberg HDL filters list 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5 and 6 inch ports; Solberg LRS liquid separators list 3/4, 1 and 1-1/2 inch; Solberg HDL 3 to 8 inch filters list 250 to 1100 cfm (300 cfm at 3 inch and 500 cfm at 4 inch, 99.97 percent efficiency) and the 2 inch HDL filters 125 to 175 cfm; Gast VG generators give 62 to 481 LPM; 121 deg C is about 250 deg F and 60 deg C is 140 deg F; Value Line vacuum generators give 16 LPM with 6 mm or 1/4 inch tube ports and Value Line pads are 20 to 75 mm with 5 pads per pack.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics product listings compiled from the maker catalogues

faqs.q: What are the Solberg LRS right-angle liquid separators used for?
faqs.a: The Solberg LRS right-angle liquid separators remove oil and liquid from an air or vacuum line before the pump, with a drain included. This listing carries 5 part numbers: LRS-19-075HC (3/4"), LRS-19-100HC (1"), LRS-19-150HC (1-1/2"), LRS-237-250HC and LRS-237-300HC.

faqs.q: How do I read Solberg part numbers such as LRS-19-100HC and LRS-237-300HC?
faqs.a: In the rows LRS-19 numbers carry the size in the ending (-075 is 3/4", -100 is 1" and -150 is 1-1/2") and LRS-237 is a larger body, with -250 and -300 as its two versions. HC is common to all five.

faqs.q: Which sizes do Solberg LRS separators come in?
faqs.a: 3/4", 1" and 1-1/2" on the LRS-19 body, and LRS-237-250HC and LRS-237-300HC, which are listed only as right angle liquid separators without a stated size.

faqs.q: What is the difference between LRS-19 and LRS-237 separators?
faqs.a: LRS-19 is the smaller body in 3/4" to 1-1/2" sizes, while LRS-237 is the larger right-angle body; the listing gives A 431.8 mm and C 195.07 mm for the series. Quote the part number so we confirm size.

faqs.q: What ratings does the Solberg LRS separator have?
faqs.a: The listing gives dimensions of 431.8 mm A, 195.07 mm C and 76.2 mm D, with a drain included, but no pressure, flow or temperature rating. We confirm them with Solberg for your part number.

faqs.q: What does the Solberg LRS separator filter?
faqs.a: The specification lists oil as the filtered substance in air, with a drain included. Body materials are not stated, so send your conditions and we confirm with Solberg.

faqs.q: Which documents are available for Solberg LRS separators?
faqs.a: No certificate or datasheet is attached to the the Solberg LRS separators listing. Tell us in the enquiry what your file requires for LRS-19-100HC, such as a conformity certificate, and we obtain it from Solberg with the order.

faqs.q: What do I connect to a Solberg LRS separator?
faqs.a: Piping on the inlet and outlet at the right angle, a drain line, and the vacuum pump or compressor downstream. See our [pneumatic fittings and silencers](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers) shelf.

faqs.q: How do I install and drain a Solberg LRS separator?
faqs.a: Install it ahead of the pump with the drain at the bottom, drain it regularly and check for liquid carry-over. See the [compressed air quality guide](/blog/compressed-air-quality-iso-8573-1).

faqs.q: How does the Solberg LRS differ from the Solberg HDL filters?
faqs.a: LRS separates liquid and particulate upstream, while the [Solberg HDL filters](/p/solberg-hdl-series-discharge-oil-mist-filters-3-8-inch) coalesce oil mist at the pump exhaust. Quote the part number you need and we confirm the right match.

faqs.q: Where are Solberg LRS separators made and how are they exported?
faqs.a: The country of origin for the Solberg LRS separators depends on the maker plant that built the batch, and we state it on the commercial invoice for each shipment. We export from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and other markets with a commercial invoice and packing list. Filtering machinery falls under HS heading 8421.

faqs.a: Yes. Solberg LRS series right-angle liquid separators is kept in stock in our Dubai, UAE warehouse, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, list the part numbers and quantities on [the contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are the Value Line vacuum generators used for?
faqs.a: The Value Line vacuum generators are small compressed-air ejectors that make vacuum for suction pads, giving 16 LPM. This listing carries 3 part numbers: VL06I (6 mm), VL06T with a 1/4" tube port and VL06T with 6 mm ports.

faqs.q: How do I read Value Line part numbers such as VL06T, 6mm and VL06T, 1/4?
faqs.a: In the rows VL06 is the generator, the letter I or T names the style, and the suffix after the comma is the tube size, 6 mm or 1/4". The listing does not decode the I and T letters, so quote the full part number.

faqs.q: Which tube sizes do the Value Line vacuum generators have?
faqs.a: The three part numbers have 6 mm pressure and vacuum ports (VL06I, 6mm and VL06T, 6mm) or 1/4" tube ports (VL06T, 1/4). Pick the one that matches your tubing.

faqs.q: What flow does the Value Line generator give?
faqs.a: All three rows state 16 LPM. The VL06T, 6mm row adds a 102 psi maximum supply pressure, about 7 bar. Quote the full part number when you order.

faqs.q: What temperature and pressure does the Value Line generator have?
faqs.a: The listing gives a temperature of 176 deg F (80 deg C) and the VL06T, 6mm row states a maximum supply pressure of 102 psi, about 7 bar. The other rows state no supply limit.

faqs.q: What is the Value Line generator made from?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the body material. Send your operating conditions and we confirm with the maker. Send the medium and operating conditions with your enquiry and we confirm material suitability with the maker.

faqs.q: Which documents are available for the Value Line generator?
faqs.a: We hold no datasheet or certificate for the Value Line vacuum generators on this page. Ask for the Value Line catalogue sheet or a certificate of conformity for VL06T, 6mm in your enquiry and we request it from Value Line when we place the order.

faqs.q: What do I connect to a Value Line vacuum generator?
faqs.a: Compressed air to the pressure port and a vacuum line to the pad, in 6 mm or 1/4" tube; see our [pneumatic tubing](/c/pneumatic-tubing) shelf and the [Value Line pads](/p/value-line-vacuum-pads).

faqs.q: How do I install a Value Line generator?
faqs.a: Mount it close to the pad, connect supply and vacuum tube and check the vacuum with the part held. Keep supply at or below 102 psi on the 6 mm version.

faqs.q: How do the Value Line generators differ from the Gast VG generators?
faqs.a: The Value Line units give 16 LPM with tube ports, while the [Gast VG generators](/p/gast-vacuum-generators) give 62 to 481 LPM with NPT ports. Quote the part number you need and we confirm the right match.

faqs.q: Where are Value Line vacuum generators made and how are they exported?
faqs.a: The country of origin for the Value Line vacuum generators depends on the maker plant that built the batch, and we state it on the commercial invoice for each shipment. We export from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and other markets with a commercial invoice and packing list. Items of this kind fall under HS heading 8414, 8421 or 8481 depending on the product.

faqs.a: Yes, we stock Value Line vacuum generators at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send us the exact part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) and we quote promptly.

faqs.q: What are the Value Line vacuum pad adapters used for?
faqs.a: The Value Line pad adapters connect Value Line pads to a vacuum line, in packs of 5. This listing carries 12 part numbers in 6, 10 and 12 mm port sizes, for pads of 20 to 75 mm.

faqs.q: How do I read Value Line adapter numbers such as Fitting D=10, G1/4 - G1/8?
faqs.a: In the rows D is the port size in mm (6, 10 or 12) and the two threads after it give the connection pair, such as G1/4 to G1/8 or 3/8 NPT to 1/4 NPSF. Each row is a different thread combination.

faqs.q: Which pad sizes do the Value Line adapters suit?
faqs.a: The D=6 adapters suit 20 mm to 30 mm pads, the D=10 adapters 40 mm to 50 mm pads and the D=12 adapters 60 mm to 75 mm pads, four thread versions each.

faqs.q: Which threads do the Value Line pad adapters have?
faqs.a: Rows list 1/4 NPT to 1/8 NPSF, 1/8 NPT to M5, G1/4 to G1/8 and G1/8 to M5 on D=6, and 3/8 NPT to 1/4 NPSF, G3/8 to G1/4 and others on D=10 and D=12. Choose the pair that matches your line.

faqs.q: What temperature can the Value Line pad adapters take?
faqs.a: The listing gives 121 deg C, which is about 250 deg F. It holds no pressure rating, so we confirm the limits with the maker. We confirm the maker's rating for your exact part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What are the Value Line pad adapters made of?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the adapter material. Send your operating conditions and we confirm with the maker. Send the medium and operating conditions with your enquiry and we confirm material suitability with the maker.

faqs.q: Which documents are available for the Value Line adapters?
faqs.a: This listing holds no datasheet or certificate file for the Value Line pad adapters, so name the document you need, for example a certificate of conformity or the Value Line catalogue page for a D=10 adapter, and we request it from Value Line with the order.

faqs.q: What pads and lines do Value Line adapters connect?
faqs.a: They connect the [Value Line vacuum pads](/p/value-line-vacuum-pads) to your vacuum line; see the [vacuum generators, pads and filters shelf](/c/vacuum-components) for ejectors and our [pneumatic fittings and silencers](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers) shelf.

faqs.q: How do I fit a Value Line pad adapter?
faqs.a: Thread the adapter into the pad and the line fitting, using thread sealant on NPT threads and checking for leaks before lifting. Each pack holds 5.

faqs.q: How do the Value Line adapters differ from the SMC ZP adaptors?
faqs.a: Value Line adapters suit 20 mm to 75 mm pads with 6 to 12 mm ports, while the [SMC ZP adaptors](/p/smc-zp-series-vacuum-pad) are metric M4 to M8 and 1/8" fittings for SMC pads.

faqs.q: Where are Value Line pad adapters made and how are they exported?
faqs.a: The country of origin for the Value Line pad adapters depends on the maker plant that built the batch, and we state it on the commercial invoice for each shipment. We export from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and other markets with a commercial invoice and packing list. Items of this kind fall under HS heading 8414, 8421 or 8481 depending on the product.

faqs.a: Yes. Our Dubai, UAE warehouse keeps Value Line vacuum pad adapters in stock, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. [The contact page](/contact) is the quickest way to request a quotation with part numbers and quantities.

faqs.q: What are the Value Line vacuum pads used for?
faqs.a: The Value Line vacuum pads are thermoplastic elastomer suction pads in bellows and flat styles, sold in packs of 5. This listing carries 20 part numbers, such as VL20BX, VL50BL and VL75FC, in diameters of 20 mm to 75 mm.

faqs.q: How do I read Value Line pad numbers such as VL25BL and VL40FC?
faqs.a: In the rows VL and the diameter (25, 40) are followed by B for bellows or F for flat, and X or L or C for the version: VL25BX is 22.5 mm high and VL25BL 34 mm high, and the flat VL25FC is 16 mm high.

faqs.q: Which diameters and heights do the Value Line pads come in?
faqs.a: Bellows pads run 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60 and 75 mm (VL20BX 20 mm high, VL75BL 93 mm high) and flat pads 20 to 75 mm (VL20FC 15 mm high, VL75FC 38.5 mm high).

faqs.q: What is the difference between the BX and BL Value Line pads?
faqs.a: Both are bellows pads of the same diameter, but BL is taller: VL50BX is 44 mm high and VL50BL 63 mm high. Choose the taller pad where more compliance is needed.

faqs.q: What temperature can the Value Line pads take?
faqs.a: The listing gives 0 deg C to 60 deg C and a 60A durometer, which is about 32 to 140 deg F. They are not suited to hot parts. We confirm the maker's rating for your exact part number with the quotation.

faqs.q: What are the Value Line pads made from?
faqs.a: The specification gives thermoplastic elastomer with a 60A durometer, supplied as a plain pad without adapter. Confirm oil and chemical compatibility with us before use.

faqs.q: Which documents are available for the Value Line pads?
faqs.a: No certificate or datasheet is attached to the the Value Line pads listing. Tell us in the enquiry what your file requires for VL25BL, such as a conformity certificate, and we obtain it from Value Line with the order.

faqs.q: What adapter fits a Value Line vacuum pad?
faqs.a: The pads are plain, so fit one of the [Value Line pad adapters](/p/value-line-vacuum-pad-adapters): D=6 for 20 to 30 mm pads, D=10 for 40 to 50 mm and D=12 for 60 to 75 mm.

faqs.q: How do I choose and fit a Value Line pad?
faqs.a: Choose the diameter from the load, apply a safety factor, fit the adapter and check the vacuum before lifting; see our [grippers and vacuum guide](/blog/pneumatic-grippers-and-vacuum-guide).

faqs.q: How do the Value Line pads differ from the SMC bellows pads?
faqs.a: The Value Line pads are thermoplastic elastomer to 60 deg C in 20 to 75 mm, while the [SMC bellows pads](/p/smc-vacuum-pad-bellows) are fluoro rubber and other grades up to 250 deg C in 6 to 50 mm.
